title: Nussbaum - P&L, Oct 2026 (built with =NS formulas)
narration: This is the NetSuite add-in for Excel. It adds a NetSuite button to the Home tab.
The first time, you sign in with your Nussbaum Microsoft account. You don't need a NetSuite login.
Type NetSuite formulas into any cell. N S dot ACTIVITY returns the activity for an account, or a range of accounts. Here, October revenue for Nussbaum Transportation.
Fill in the rest of the statement. Every cell Excel calculates together goes to NetSuite in a single request.
N S dot BALANCE returns ending balances, like cash and accounts receivable.
If there's a typo, the cell shows an error with the reason. It never shows a wrong number.
To see where a number comes from, select the cell and click Show detail.
A new sheet lists every NetSuite line behind that number, and it always adds up exactly to the cell.
You can also pull complete reports, like the trial balance, onto a new sheet.
Everything is read only, and every pull is checked against NetSuite's own totals before it reaches Excel.
